inspection.scope: Five provenance-distinct source layers were explicitly inspected before canonical extraction: Ngati Toa Rangatira iwi-controlled programme framing, Ngai Tahu iwi leadership/public-history framing, Waitangi Tribunal institutional interpretation framing, Public Service Commission Crown/public-service conduct framing, and Te Pati Maori party-scoped constitutional framing.
inspection.uncertainty: These source layers are actor-scoped and function-scoped. Two iwi do not establish Maori consensus; Tribunal interpretation does not establish a timeless national view; Public Service Commission conduct framing does not establish Crown consensus or legal effect; Te Pati Maori is party-scoped. Legal holdings remain LAW-owned, exact Treaty wording remains TEXT-owned, and occurrence chronology remains EVENT-owned.
